proposals.mechanistic_rationale: The source demonstrates survival and later cleavage of both silyl ethers. Nucleophilic attack at silicon one intermediate earlier should give the unprotected C16-ketone and expose a new order for ketoreduction and selective acylation.
elementary_steps: fluoride coordination and attack at silicon
falsifiable_checks: LC-MS time course must show loss of both silyl groups
C16 ketone must remain at least 95 percent intact
bufadienolide isomerization or decomposition must remain at most 5 percent
